answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust kernel for Sybil resistance in multi-agent systems by tethering identity to capital commitment. An attacker scaling across the digital ridge of the network faces the juniper cost of locking significant collateral to gain influence, rendering the creation of infinite sub-entities economically prohibitive. By requiring verifiable stake, the protocol ensures that identity acquisition is not merely a computational task but a fiscal liability that forces attackers to bear the consequences of network devaluation.
